q: Who scored the only goal of Watford's 1984 FA Cup semi-final win over Plymouth Argyle?
hint: The 6ft 4in centre-forward headed in a John Barnes cross after eleven minutes. Blissett was in Italy for the whole of that season.

q: John Barnes left Watford in 1987 to join which club?
hint: The £900,000 move took him to Anfield, where he won two league titles. He had cost Watford next to nothing from non-league Sudbury Court six years earlier.

q: Watford reached the 1984 FA Cup final by winning a semi-final at Villa Park against which club?
hint: Their opponents were a Third Division side, and it remains the only time that club has reached an FA Cup semi-final.

q: Watford reached the 1999 play-off final by beating Birmingham City on penalties in the semi-final. What was the shootout score?
hint: The tie finished 1-1 on aggregate after extra time and the shootout ran deep into sudden death.

q: Luther Blissett was sold in 1983, after topping the First Division scoring charts, to which Italian club?
hint: The £1 million move followed his 27-goal league season. He managed only five league goals in Italy and was back at Vicarage Road a year later.

q: Graham Taylor left Watford in May 1987 to manage which club?
hint: He took his new club straight back to the top flight in 1988-89, then to First Division runners-up in 1989-90, before becoming England manager in 1990.
